name: Admin criar agendamento manual
description: Admin logado cria um novo agendamento manual para um cliente

planSteps.description: Login with email elberthmayan2007@gmail.com and password mayan123
Click 'Novo Agendamento' or 'Agendar' button from the dashboard or sidebar
Verify the booking form shows steps for client, service, date/time, and review
Type 'Teste Admin' in the client name field
Type 11988888888 in the client phone field
Click next to proceed to service selection
Verify the service selection step shows at least one service
Click next to proceed to date/time selection
Verify a date picker and available time slots are shown
Select an available date and time
Click next or confirm to review the booking
Verify the review step shows all booking details correctly
